title: Optimizing Multi-Scalar Multiplication Over Fixed Bases
content: This work investigates multi-scalar multiplication (MSM) over a fixed base for small input sizes, where classical large-scale optimizations are less effective. We propose a novel variant of the Pippenger-based bucket method that enhance performance by using additional precomputation. In particular, our approach extends the BGMW method by introducing structured precomputations of point combinations, enabling the replacement of multiple point additions with table lookups. We further generalize this idea through chunk-based precomputation, allowing flexible trade-offs between memory usage and runtime performance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed variants significantly outperform the Fixed Window method for small MSM instances, achieving up to 3× speedup under practical memory constraints. These results challenge the common assumption that bucket-based methods are inefficient for small MSMs.
